name: Baseball With Display Case
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality white PU leather with classic red stitching, offering the authentic look and feel of a traditional baseball.
    - Soft-touch surface with excellent durability, making it ideal for display, collecting, or gifting.
    - Comes with a premium clear acrylic display case to protect the baseball from dust while showcasing it beautifully.
    - Standard baseball size with detailed craftsmanship and realistic stitching for an authentic appearance.
    - Designed as a decorative keepsake rather than for professional gameplay.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Baseball Diameter: 2.95 inches ~ 7.5 cm
    - Display Case: 3.15 × 3.15 × 3.15 inches ~ 8 × 8 × 8 cm
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for sharp detail, vibrant color, and a long-lasting decorative surface.
    - Available in three printing options:
            +) 1-Sided Printing: Design printed on the front side only.
            +) 2-Sided Printing: Different or matching designs printed on both the front and back.
            +) Full Printing: Custom artwork wraps around the entire baseball surface for a seamless, full-coverage appearance.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized keepsake, collectible, or display piece for baseball fans and sports enthusiasts.
    - Includes a clear acrylic display case to protect the baseball while allowing it to be showcased from every angle.
    - Perfect for displaying on desks, bookshelves, display cabinets, offices, sports rooms, or trophy shelves.
    - Ideal for commemorating championships, tournaments, team achievements, special events, or unforgettable baseball memories.
    - A meaningful way to personalize with names, photos, logos, team artwork, or special messages.
    - Suitable as both a decorative display item and a treasured collectible for years to come.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for baseball players, coaches, teammates, parents, family members, friends, or sports fans.
    - Perfect for Birthdays, Father's Day, Mother's Day, Coach Appreciation, Team Banquets, Senior Night, Little League, School Sports, Championships, Tournaments, Graduations, Retirement, Christmas, Anniversaries, and other special occasions.
    - Personalized with names, photos, team logos, or heartfelt messages to create a one-of-a-kind keepsake.
    - A memorable gift that celebrates achievements, milestones, and unforgettable moments on and off the field.
    - A timeless collectible that will be proudly displayed and cherished for years to come. ⚾🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Baseball With Display Case

 

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
